The GOLFTEC App is equipped with performance-enhancing tools, leveraging its on-course GPS and game-tracking features to provide insightful analysis of your play.

On-Course Performance

Play Golf with On-Course GPS
Our precise GPS tool calculates exact yardage distances to any point on the golf course. See the course in extreme detail with adjustable distances, Club selection recommendations, Coach strategy, infographic overlays and more

Green Views
Know the best place to land your approach shot or line up your putts with detailed heat map showing Elevation Change and Slope for every green.

Stat Tracking and Performance Insights
Improve your game with GOLFTEC's Performance insights. The platform helps you gather and analyze performance data from a variety of sources, such as on-course stats, launch monitor numbers, and swing motion measurements.

Improvement Tools

Record Your Swing
Use your phone with the GOLFTEC App to record or upload your swings from the front or side anywhere you want. The app automatically trims, automatically centers, shows club path and body motion. 

Review Lessons & Drills
Dive deep into your previous lessons with videos of your swings, coach analysis and drills from any of your previous lessons. You'll never miss the tips and tools you need to work on your game with the GOLFTEC App in your pocket!

My Game Management with Skills Challenges, Bag Mapping & More
See your club fittings, Skills Challenge results and make a digital catalog of your golf equipment where you can add your clubs and keep track of their distances. Just a few of the tools you can use to improve your game!

Book & Change Lessons
The app makes it easy to book your lessons, club fittings and practice sessions. With monthly views and easy-to-see availability, managing your schedule is easy.

Access to the Pro Shop
You'll have access to the GOLFTEC Pro Shop in the App where you can find curated golf products that help you play and enjoy the game even more. Current students and plus subscribers will also have special discounted pricing exclusive to GOLFTEC that can't be found anywhere else!
